༄༅/ /gsang bdag 'khor chen gyi nang mchod bla brgyud kyi gsol 'debs smon lam shis brjod bstod pa rnams bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gsang bdag 'khor chen gyi nang mchod bla brgyud

kyi gsol 'debs smon lam shis brjod bstod pa rnams bzhugs/ 'dir 'khor chen gyi nang mchod bla brgyud/ /de'i gsol 'debs smon lam/ shis brjod rnams rim par 'chad pa la bzhi/ /dang po ni/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi= zhes pa nas/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gi zhal du= gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje'i= ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seṅge'i gdong ba can gyi= grub chen sa ba ri ba'i= grub chen dza ba ri ba'i= paṇa chen de ba pu ṇya ma ti'i= sgra bsgyur chos bzang po'i= bshes ston rin chen dngos grub kyi= dmar sgang ba chos rgyal mtshan gyi= sgang ston pradzña gu ru'i= sgang ston shes rab 'bum gyi= grub ston shes rab grub kyi= grub ston rdo rje seṅge'i= rong ba chos kyi mgon po'i= mnga' ris sangs rgyas ye shes kyi= 'jam dbyangs chos brtson 'grus kyi= rje btsun chos kyi dpal ba'i= chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po'i= 'dul 'dzin grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa ni dbang brgyud do// //gnyis pa ni/ na mo badzra pā ṇi ye/ /ma lus dkyil 'khor rigs kun gyi/ /khyab bdag dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*/ /zung 'jug dang po'i mgon po la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub stsol/ /rig sngags 'chang ba kun gyi rje/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa dang*/ /mkha' 'gro seṅge'i gdod can la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub stsol/ /lam 'dis rtogs pa mchog brnyes pa'i/ /grub chen sa ba ri pa dang*/ /mkhas grub dza ba ri ba la/ /gsol ba= /gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇḍi ta/ /de ba pu ṇya ma ti dang*/ /sgra bsgyur chen po chos bzang la/ /gsol ba= /gzhung lugs 'byed pa'i rnam dpyod can/ /bshes ston rin chen dngos grub dang*/ /dmar sgang chos kyi rgyal mtshan la/ /gsol ba= /gsang sngags gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin pa/ /sgang ston pradzña gu ru

dang*/ /sgang ston shes rab 'bum pa la/ /gsol ba= /rigs tshul de nyid la mkhas pa/ /grub ston shes rab grub pa dang*/ /grub ston rdo rje seṅge la/ /gsol ba= /rnam dag bslab pa dang ldan pa/ /rong ba chos kyi mgon po dang*/ /mnga' ris sangs rgyas ye shes la/ /gsol pa= /mdo rgyud man ngag mdzod 'dzin pa/ /'jam dbyangs chos kyi brtson 'grus dang*/ /rje btsun chos kyi dpal ba la/ /gsol ba= /rdo rje 'chang dbang dus kyi mthar/ /ngur smrig gar bsgyur tsong kha pa/ /de sras 'dul ba 'dzin pa la/ /gsol ba= /lam 'di'i dbang lung man ngag gi /bshad srol dag pa'i rgyun 'chang ba/ /dngos brgyud bla ma thams cad la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub stsol/ /deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /yang dag dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis/ /dgyes bzhin rjes su bzung nas kyang*/ /mdo sngags dam chos kun 'dzin shog /khyad par gsang bdag 'khor lo che'i/ /chos tshul ji bzhin nyams blangs nas/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /byang chub mchog la 'god gyur cig /gsum pa ni/ de ltar mi phyed brtan po'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po'i lha yi tshogs/ / bsgoms dang mchod bstod bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor las/ /'khrungs pa'i rnam dkar ji snyed mchis pa des/ /mar gyur 'gro ba mtha' dag srid mtsho las/ / bsgral nas bla med rdzogs byang dam pa la/ /'god 'dod byang chub sems bskyed sdom bzung nas/ /phyin drug spyod la rtag tu 'jug par shog /thun mong lam gyis rang rgyud smin byas nas/ /rdo rje theg pa'i 'jug ngogs la zhugs te/ /dbang dus ji ltar khas blangs dam tshig dang*/ /sdom pa ma lus tshul bzhin srung bar shog /bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin gyi lha tshogs rnams/ /nam mkhar khyab pa'i bsod nams zhing mchog la/ /mchod bstod gsol bas rim gnyis skye ba yi/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su smin par shog /gzung 'dzin chos kun stong ba'i dang nyid las/

/'byung bzhi ri rab sna tshogs rdo rje'i steng*/ /gzhal yas khang bsgoms ma dag snod sbyangs te/ /rnam dag rgyal ba'i zhing bzang 'grub pa shog /der ni bde gshegs yongs kyi mthu stobs kun/ /gcig bsdus gsang bdag 'khor bcas rab bskyed de/ /rtse gcig bsgoms shing mchod bstod bzlas sogs kyis/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa legs par mthar phyin shog /de nas rdzogs rim mchog gi rnal 'byor gyis/ /zung 'jug rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob nas/ /grangs med sprul pa'i gar gyis rnam rol bas/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba ma lus sgrol bar shog /de ma thob kyi tshe rabs kun tu yang*/ /dal 'byor rten rnyed sngags kyi sgor zhugs te/ /thun mong min pa'i rim gnyis rnal 'byor kun/ / tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i skal ba ldan gyur cig /bzhi ba ni/ rab yangs lta yi lam kun yongs khyab pa'i/ /bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor ba/ kha cig me tog char 'bebs shis pa brjod/ /gzhan dag mi mthun zlog pa'i 'phrin las kyis/ khyed la bde legs dpa' ster shes kyis dang*/ /shis brjod gdangs snyan bdag gis bsgrag par bya/ /mtha' yas rgyal ba kun gyis mgrin gcig tu/ /mthu stobs bdag po nyid du rabs sngags pa/ /gsang sngags rig sngags 'chang rnams kun gyi rje/ /bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin la gus phyag 'tshal/ /de yi chos tshul spel ba'i byed po mchog /ye shes mkha' 'gro seṅge'i gdong ba can/ /grub pa mchog brnyes sa ba ri pa sogs/ /dngos dang brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa la/ /legs tshogs ji snyed mchis pa'i bkra shis des/ khyed kyi mi mthun rgud la kun sel cing*/ /bde legs yang ngo'i zla ltar 'phel gyur nas/ /phun tshogs dpal la rol ba'i bkra shis shog /dug lnga rnam dag ye shes lnga yi dngos/ /bde gshegs khro rgyal chen po rigs lnga dang*/ /sgo ba rnam bzhi rang rig yum dang bcas/ /bcom ldan 'khor lo chen po'i lha tshogs la/

/legs tshogs= khyed kyi= /bde legs= /phun tshogs= /thub pa'i legs par bshad pa'i phul byung mchog /rtsa ba'i rgyud chen drag po gsum 'dul sogs/ /bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje'i rgyud rnams dang*/ /sgrub thabs mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa la/ / legs tshogs= khyed kyi= /bde legs= /phun tshogs= /rab 'byams zhing na rdo rje 'dzin pa yi/ /dbang lung man ngag rim gnyis rnal 'byor sogs/ /chos kyi tshul rnams ji bzhin 'dzin mdzad cing*/ /mchog thun dngos grub sgrub par brtson rnams la/ /legs tshogs= khyed kyi= /bde legs= /phun tshogs= /ngo bo ye shes rang bzhin las grub cing*/ /mtho yangs nyi zla lta bu'i 'od phung 'phro/ /rab mdzes dbang bo'i gzhu bzhin rnam bkra ba/ /rin chen rgyan gyis spras pa'i gzhal med cher/ /legs tshogs= khyed kyi= /bde legs= /phun tshogs dpal la rol ba'i bkra shis shog /ces gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po'i nang mchod bla brgyud dang*/ bla brgyud kyi gsol 'debs/ smon lam/ /shis brjod dang bcas pa 'di ni/ /skar rtsis sogs rig gnas du ma la rnam dpyod yangs shing*/ rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bstan pa 'dzin pa'i thugs bskyed brtan po can/ bstan pa'i mnga' bdag dpon chung rin po che blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhabs kyis/ /rang gi dgon 'dir sngar dkyil chog mang bo zhig tshugs 'dug na'ang*/ /gsang bdag gi cho ga ma btsugs par gzigs nas/ de nyid spar du bsgrubs te rang nyid kyi sku skal du me lug lo'i drug pa chu stod kyi dus chen la gsar du 'dzug par bzhed pa'i tshe bskul ba ltar/ shākya'i btsun pa bshad sgrub ming can gyis rang la'ang phan yon 'dug bsams te/ co ne dgon nyid du sbyar pa'o// //'di'i mdun bskyed la sgos kyi bstod pa mi snang zhing*/ /bdag bskyed kyi bstod pa cung zad bsdus par 'dug pas/ mdun bskyed la cung zad rgyas pa 'di bzhin bstod pa legs par bsams te/

'don mi 'don gang ltar yang brjod na/ /'di ltar ro/ khyab bdag dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang chen dang*/ /dbyer med sku bzhi'i bdag nyid chos kyi rje/ /mchog thun dngos grub 'byung gnas bsam 'phel dbang*/ /rdo rje can zhabs padmor gus phyag 'tshal/ 1 /rgyal ba kun gyi mthu stobs nus pa'i tshogs/ /gcig bsdus bde gshegs kun gyi gsang ba'i mdzod/ /'dzin mdzad phyag na rdo rjer rab grags pa/ /gdug pa mtha' dag 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo/ 2 /rnam shes yongs dag chos dbyings ye shes dngos/ /sku mdog mthing nag char sprin phung bo bzhin/ /tshangs pa brgya byin gdan steng rab brjid pa/ /'khor lo chen po yab yum la phyag 'tshal/ 3 / gzugs phung rnam dag me long lta bu'i dngos/ /sku mdog rab dkar gangs ri'i phung bo bzhin/ /dri za pho mo'i gdan steng rab brjid pa/ /bdud las rgyal byed yab yum la phyag 'tshal/ 4 /tshor phung rnam dag mnyam pa nyid kyi dngos/ /sku mdog rab ser gser gyi lhun po bzhin/ /gshin rje pho mo'i gdan steng rab brjid pa/ /rdo rje gzi brjid yab yum la phyag 'tshal/ 5 /'du shes rnam dag so sor rtog pa'i dngos/ /sku mdog rab dmar byu ru'i phung bo bzhin/ /chu lha pho mo'i gdan steng rab brjid pa/ /rngam pa'i sgra sgrogs yab yum la phyag 'tshal/ 6 / 'du byed rnam dag bya ba grub pa'i dngos/ /sku mdog ljang khu mar gad phung bo bzhin/ /gnod sbyin pho mo'i gdan steng rab brjid pa/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil ba yab yum la phyag 'tshal/ 7 /dad stobs rnam dag byams pa tshad med dngos/ /shel dkar phung bo ji bzhin dag pa'i sku/ /zhi ba'i 'phrin las ma lus sgrub mdzad pa/ /rdo rje lcags kyu yab yum la phyag 'tshal/ 8 /brtson 'grus rnam dag snying rje tshad med dngos/ /dri bral gtso ma'i gser ltar mdzes pa'i sku/ /rgyas pa'i 'phrin las ma lus sgrub mdzad pa/ /rdo rje zhags pa yab yum phyag 'tshal/

9 /dran pa rnam dag dga' ba tshad med dngos/ /padma rā ga'i mdangs bzhin gsal ba'i sku/ /dbang gi 'phrin las ma lus sgrub mdzad pa/ /rdo rje lcags sgrogs yab yum la phyag 'tshal/ 10 /ting 'dzin rnam dag btang snyoms tshad med dngos/ /dri med g.yu yi mchod sdong lta bu'i sku/ /drag po'i 'phrin las ma lus sgrub mdzad pa/ /rdo rje dril bu yab yum la phyag 'tshal/ 11 /dngos grub mchog ni bde chen lam nyid kyis/ /thob pa mtshon phyir phan tshun mnyam sbyor bas/ /lhan skyes bde stong mchog la rtag rol ba/ / dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ 12 /de ltar bstod pa'i rnam dkar phung po des/ /'gal rkyen mi mthun bdud las rnam rgyal te/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi grub chen brgyad la sogs/ /dngos grub ma lus bde blag thob gyur cig /13 //ces gsang bdag 'khor chen gyi dkyil 'khor ba rnams la bstod pa byin rlabs myur 'jug ces bya ba 'di yang*/ bshad sgrub ming can gyis dad pas sbyar pa'o/ /bkra shis// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/ gsang bdag 'khor chen gyi nang mchod bla brgyud gsol 'debs smon lam shis brjod bstod pa rnams bzhugs/ - PAGE 310-- PAGE 309-- PAGE 304-
